```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("contig_annotate")

ca <- function(...) p("results", "contig_annotate", ...)
assemblies <- ctx$assemblies

genes <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
  file <- ca("prodigal", a, paste0(a, ".prodigal_plain.gtf"))
  if (!file.exists(file) || file.size(file) == 0) return(NULL)
  read_tsv(file, col_names = c("contig", "source", "type", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "phase", "attributes"),
           col_select = c(contig, start, end, attributes), show_col_types = FALSE, comment = "#") %>%
    transmute(
      assembly_id = a, contig, length = end - start + 1,
      partial = sub(";.*$", "", sub("^.*partial=", "", attributes)),
      gc = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub(";.*$", "", sub("^.*gc_cont=", "", attributes))))
    )
})
gene_summary <- if (nrow(genes) > 0) {
  genes %>%
    group_by(assembly_id) %>%
    summarise(
      genes = n(), contigs_with_genes = n_distinct(contig), mean_length = mean(length), median_length = median(length),
      complete_pct = 100 * mean(partial == "00"), mean_gc = 100 * mean(gc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"
    )
} else {
  tibble()
}

# Whitespace-separated tables of HMMER: target, accession, query, accession, E-value, score, ...
hmmer_dbs <- names(ctx$features$databases$hmmer)
hmmer <- map_dfr(hmmer_dbs, function(db) {
  thresholds <- ctx$params$contig_annotate$hmmer$domt
  threshold <- thresholds[[db]] %||% thresholds$fallback %||% 0
  map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
    file <- ca("hmmer", db, paste0(a, ".tblout.tsv"))
    if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
    lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
    lines <- lines[!startsWith(lines, "#")]
    fields <- strsplit(trimws(lines), "[[:space:]]+")
    tibble(
      database = db, assembly_id = a, threshold = threshold,
      hits = length(lines),
      proteins_over_threshold = sum(map_dbl(fields, ~ as.numeric(.x[[6]])) >= threshold)
    )
  })
})

counts <- map_dfr(Sys.glob(ca("featurecounts", "*", "*.prodigal_fc.txt.summary")), function(file) {
  table <- read_table_quiet(file)
  names(table) <- c("status", "reads")
  name <- sub("\\.prodigal_fc\\.txt\\.summary$", "", basename(file))
  assembly <- basename(dirname(file))
  tibble(
    assembly_id = assembly,
    library = sub(paste0("^", assembly, "_"), "", name),
    total = sum(table$reads),
    assigned = sum(table$reads[table$status == "Assigned"]),
    no_features = sum(table$reads[table$status == "Unassigned_NoFeatures"]),
    unmapped = sum(table$reads[table$status == "Unassigned_Unmapped"]),
    ambiguous = sum(table$reads[table$status == "Unassigned_Ambiguity"]),
    multi = sum(table$reads[table$status == "Unassigned_MultiMapping"])
  )
})

# The rule uses --no_file_comments, so the file normally has no header, and the columns are in this order
EMAPPER_COLUMNS <- c("query", "seed_ortholog", "evalue", "score", "eggNOG_OGs", "max_annot_lvl", "COG_category", "Description",
                     "Preferred_name", "GOs", "EC", "KEGG_ko", "KEGG_Pathway", "KEGG_Module", "KEGG_Reaction", "KEGG_rclass",
                     "BRITE", "KEGG_TC", "CAZy", "BiGG_Reaction", "PFAMs")
read_emapper <- function(file) {
  lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  header <- grep("^#query", lines)[1]
  body <- lines[!startsWith(lines, "#")]
  if (length(body) == 0) return(NULL)
  columns <- if (is.na(header)) EMAPPER_COLUMNS else strsplit(sub("^#", "", lines[[header]]), "\t")[[1]]
  table <- read_tsv(I(paste(body, collapse = "\n")), col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE, quote = "")
  names(table) <- c(columns, paste0("extra_", seq_len(max(0, ncol(table) - length(columns)))))[seq_len(ncol(table))]
  table
}
eggnog <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
  file <- ca("eggnog", a, "eggnog_output.emapper.annotations")
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  table <- read_emapper(file)
  if (is.null(table)) return(NULL)
  transmute(table, assembly_id = a, query, COG_category, KEGG_ko, Description)
})
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  sentences <- c(
    if (nrow(gene_summary) > 0) {
      paste0("Prodigal predicted **", fmt_int(sum(gene_summary$genes)), " genes** in ", nrow(gene_summary), " assemblies, of which ", fmt_pct(100 * mean(genes$partial == "00")),
             " are complete. The rest are cut at a contig end, which is usual in short contigs.")
    },
    if (nrow(counts) > 0) {
      paste0("Between ", fmt_pct(min(100 * counts$assigned / counts$total)), " and ", fmt_pct(max(100 * counts$assigned / counts$total)), " of the read fragments are assigned to genes (featureCounts).")
    },
    if (nrow(hmmer) > 0) {
      paste0("HMMER found ", fmt_int(sum(hmmer$proteins_over_threshold)), " hydrogenase proteins over the score thresholds.")
    },
    if (nrow(eggnog) > 0) {
      paste0("eggNOG-mapper annotated ", fmt_int(nrow(eggnog)), " genes.")
    }
  )
  if (length(sentences) > 0) bullets(sentences) else para("No results of contig annotation were found yet.")
})
```

```{r prodigal}
section("Gene prediction with Prodigal", {
  if (nrow(gene_summary) == 0) {
    no_output("Prodigal", "results/contig_annotate/prodigal/")
  } else {
    para("Prodigal in metagenome mode finds protein-coding genes without training on one genome. **Complete** genes have both a start and a stop inside the contig.")
    show_table(
      gene_summary %>% transmute(
        Assembly = assembly_id, Genes = fmt_int(genes), `Contigs with genes` = fmt_int(contigs_with_genes), `Mean length` = fmt_int(mean_length),
        `Median length` = fmt_int(median_length), Complete = fmt_pct(complete_pct), GC = fmt_pct(mean_gc)
      ),
      "Predicted genes per assembly. Lengths are in bp",
      "genes_per_assembly",
      export = gene_summary,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    show_figure(
      ggplot(genes, aes(length, fill = partial == "00")) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
        scale_x_log10() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = PALETTE[[1]], `FALSE` = PALETTE[[2]]), labels = c(`TRUE` = "Complete", `FALSE` = "Partial"), name = NULL) +
        facet_wrap(~assembly_id, scales = "free_y") +
        labs(x = "Gene length (bp, logarithmic scale)", y = "Genes") +
        theme_report(),
      "gene_lengths",
      "Length of the predicted genes per assembly.",
      height = 2.6 + 1.4 * ceiling(length(assemblies) / 3)
    )
  }
})
```

```{r featurecounts}
section("Reads per gene with featureCounts", {
  if (nrow(counts) == 0) {
    no_output("featureCounts", "results/contig_annotate/featurecounts/")
  } else {
    para("featureCounts counts read pairs on the predicted genes. The gene tables are in `results/contig_annotate/featurecounts/`. Fragments that didn't map to the assembly at all count as unmapped.")
    show_table(
      counts %>% transmute(
        Assembly = assembly_id, Library = library, Fragments = fmt_int(total), Assigned = fmt_int(assigned), `Assigned %` = fmt_pct(100 * assigned / total, 2),
        `No gene` = fmt_int(no_features), Unmapped = fmt_int(unmapped), Ambiguous = fmt_int(ambiguous)
      ),
      "Read fragments per library and assembly",
      "featurecounts",
      export = counts,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    long <- counts %>%
      transmute(assembly_id, library, Assigned = assigned, `No gene` = no_features, Ambiguous = ambiguous + multi, Unmapped = unmapped, total) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(Assigned, `No gene`, Ambiguous, Unmapped), names_to = "status", values_to = "reads") %>%
      mutate(share = 100 * reads / total, library = factor(library, levels = rev(libraries())),
             status = factor(status, levels = c("Unmapped", "Ambiguous", "No gene", "Assigned")))
    show_figure(
      ggplot(long, aes(share, library, fill = status)) +
        geom_col() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(Assigned = "#009E73", `No gene` = "#56B4E9", Ambiguous = "#E69F00", Unmapped = "#999999"), name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
        facet_wrap(~assembly_id) +
        labs(x = "Read fragments (%)", y = NULL) +
        theme_report() +
        library_axis(n_distinct(long$library)),
      "featurecounts",
      "What featureCounts did with the read fragments of each library.",
      height = rows_height(n_distinct(long$library), 0.2, 1.5)
    )
  }
})
```

```{r eggnog}
section("Function with eggNOG-mapper", {
  if (nrow(eggnog) == 0) {
    no_output("eggNOG-mapper", "results/contig_annotate/eggnog/")
  } else {
    per_assembly <- eggnog %>%
      group_by(assembly_id) %>%
      summarise(annotated = n(), with_cog = sum(!is.na(COG_category) & COG_category != "-"), with_kegg = sum(!is.na(KEGG_ko) & KEGG_ko != "-"), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(genes = gene_summary$genes[match(assembly_id, gene_summary$assembly_id)])
    show_table(
      per_assembly %>% transmute(Assembly = assembly_id, Genes = fmt_int(genes), Annotated = fmt_int(annotated), `With COG` = fmt_int(with_cog), `With KEGG KO` = fmt_int(with_kegg)),
      "Genes annotated by eggNOG-mapper",
      "eggnog_per_assembly",
      export = per_assembly,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    cog <- eggnog %>%
      filter(!is.na(COG_category), COG_category != "-") %>%
      mutate(category = strsplit(COG_category, "")) %>%
      unnest(category) %>%
      count(assembly_id, category)
    if (nrow(cog) > 0) {
      write_tsv(cog, file.path(ctx$tables, "cog_categories.tsv"))
      show_figure(
        ggplot(cog, aes(category, n)) +
          geom_col(fill = PALETTE[[1]]) +
          facet_wrap(~assembly_id, scales = "free_y") +
          labs(x = "COG category", y = "Genes") +
          theme_report(),
        "cog_categories",
        "Genes per COG functional category. A gene with several categories counts for each.",
        height = 2.6 + 1.4 * ceiling(length(assemblies) / 3)
      )
    }
  }
  eggnog7 <- Sys.glob(ca("eggnog7", "*", "*.eggnog.tsv.gz"))
  if (length(eggnog7) > 0) {
    table <- tibble(file = rel(eggnog7), bytes = file.size(eggnog7))
    show_table(table %>% transmute(File = file, Size = fmt_bytes(bytes)), "Output of the eggNOG 7 search", "eggnog7_files", export = table, max_rows = 30)
  }
})
```

```{r diamond}
section("Protein searches with DIAMOND", {
  dbs <- names(ctx$features$databases$diamond_contig_protein)
  summaries <- map_dfr(dbs, function(db) {
    map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
      file <- ca("diamond", db, paste0(a, ".out"))
      if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
      lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
      tibble(database = db, assembly_id = a, hits = length(lines), proteins = n_distinct(sub("\t.*$", "", lines)))
    })
  })
  if (nrow(summaries) == 0) {
    no_output("DIAMOND", "results/contig_annotate/diamond/")
  } else {
    show_table(
      summaries %>% transmute(Database = database, Assembly = assembly_id, Hits = fmt_int(hits), `Proteins with a hit` = fmt_int(proteins)),
      "DIAMOND hits of the predicted proteins",
      "diamond_hits",
      export = summaries,
      max_rows = 40
    )
  }
})
```

```{r hmmer}
section("Hydrogenases with HMMER", {
  if (nrow(hmmer) == 0) {
    no_output("HMMER", "results/contig_annotate/hmmer/")
  } else {
    para("hmmsearch looks for hydrogenase profiles in the predicted proteins. The domain score threshold of each database comes from `config/params.yaml`. The table of a run also ",
         "lists proteins whose domains missed the threshold, and so *over threshold* counts those with a full-sequence score at or above it.")
    show_table(
      hmmer %>% transmute(Database = database, Assembly = assembly_id, Threshold = fmt_num(threshold), `Lines in the table` = fmt_int(hits), `Over threshold` = fmt_int(proteins_over_threshold)),
      "HMMER hits per database and assembly",
      "hmmer_hits",
      export = hmmer,
      max_rows = 40
    )
  }
})
```

```{r camper}
section("Polyphenol metabolism with CAMPER", {
  camper <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
    file <- ca("camper", a, "annotations.tsv")
    if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
    table <- read_table_quiet(file)
    tibble(assembly_id = a, genes = nrow(table), with_hit = sum(!is.na(table$CAMPER_hits) & nzchar(table$CAMPER_hits)))
  })
  if (nrow(camper) == 0) {
    no_output("CAMPER", "results/contig_annotate/camper/")
  } else {
    show_table(
      camper %>% transmute(Assembly = assembly_id, Genes = fmt_int(genes), `With a hit` = fmt_int(with_hit)),
      "Genes with a CAMPER hit per assembly",
      "camper",
      export = camper
    )
  }
})
```

```{r ncyc}
section("Nitrogen-cycle genes with NCycDB", {
  file <- ca("ncyc", "ncyc_results.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    no_output("NCycProfiler", "results/contig_annotate/ncyc/ncyc_results.tsv")
  } else {
    lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
    table <- read_tsv(I(paste(lines[!startsWith(lines, "#")], collapse = "\n")), show_col_types = FALSE)
    write_tsv(table, file.path(ctx$tables, "ncyc.tsv"))
    para("NCycProfiler compares the predicted proteins with NCycDB, and the first number of its file says that a random sample of ",
         sub("^#random sampling: ", "", grep("^#random", lines, value = TRUE)[1]), " sequences per assembly was used.")
    show_table(table, "Nitrogen-cycle genes per assembly", "ncyc_table", max_rows = 25)
  }
})
```

```{r methods}
section("Methods text", {
  para("You can use or adapt this text for a paper. It lists the tools with output in this project. Add database versions from the reference report.")
  sentences <- c(
    if (nrow(gene_summary) > 0) paste0("Genes were predicted on the contigs with ", tv("Prodigal"), " in metagenome mode."),
    if (nrow(counts) > 0) paste0("Read pairs on genes were counted with ", tv("featureCounts"), "."),
    if (nrow(eggnog) > 0) paste0("Proteins were annotated with ", tv("eggNOG-mapper"), "."),
    if (length(Sys.glob(ca("diamond", "*", "*.out"))) > 0) paste0("Proteins were searched against ", paste(names(ctx$features$databases$diamond_contig_protein), collapse = ", "), " with ", tv("DIAMOND"), "."),
    if (nrow(hmmer) > 0) paste0("Hydrogenases were identified with ", tv("HMMER"), " (hmmsearch) and the HydDB profiles, with score thresholds ", paste(paste0(hmmer_dbs, " ", map_chr(hmmer_dbs, ~ as.character(ctx$params$contig_annotate$hmmer$domt[[.x]] %||% "?"))), collapse = ", "), "."),
    if (file.exists(ca("ncyc", "ncyc_results.tsv"))) "Nitrogen-cycle genes were counted with NCycProfiler and NCycDB."
  )
  if (length(sentences) > 0) para("> ", paste(sentences, collapse = " ")) else para("There is no output to describe yet.")
})
```
